answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Accredited goods checker manifest record with goods checkers endorsement: 3-year training, 470 supervised checkings, practical exam, annual re-assessment. One honest agent risks 107 POA once; a farm of 754 risks 80678 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. The nebula is the evidence, the whisper is the expense, and the voyage is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
